name: WOVEN PREP (items 10, 11): Hidden Palace alone, the woven act's L (prototype HPZ act 1: west x 4688..7247, east x 7248..8351 at y 1504..2047, one paste offset)
note: A single-zone proof clip for the woven mega-act (docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-woven.md section C items 10 and 11, v2.1's Hidden Palace L): the prototype (Simon Wai) Hidden Palace, the only donor for it. Two clips of one zone with ONE paste offset (-4688, 0), exactly as v2.1 cuts it, so the place they touch is Sonic 2's own geometry. What it proves: s2_layer_lines reads the prototype's Objects_Layout row and finds zero Obj03 (a prototype Obj03 would be refused, rule L6), so zero lines; the background is HPZ's registry-driven BG (145 tiles, plane window 0, period 128 cells), transcribed from the prototype's Bg_Scroll_HPz table half and loc_6AA8 (6 bands, 3 ramp ratios approximated to the nearest engine factor, listed in the spec's approximations). WHY THE EAST PIECE STOPS AT DONOR x 8352 AND NOT v2.1's 9216 (MEASURED 2026-09-27): donor x 8448..8703 inside the east piece's band (y 1504..2047) carries NO art at all, and x 8352..8447 (in this act at 3664..3759, measured with the piece cut at 8448) no plane-A landing surface: a pit at least 352 px wide down to the donor's bottom edge (where it ends east of 8703 was not measured). clip_reachability refuses an interior artless column outright, so a solo act cannot carry it; in the woven act Metropolis west paints those columns above it and the art check passes, but the pit is still a fall to the act's bottom (woven finding, recorded in the design doc). The start is a chosen point: the donor's own start (560, 428) is in HPZ's opening, west of this piece.

start.why: On Hidden Palace's floor at x 224, surface y 1024 (MEASURED from this clip's bake: plane-A SOLID_TOP, 48 px of air above). The donor's own start (560, 428) is in HPZ's opening, outside this piece.

unpainted_remainder.why: The L is 2560 + 1104 = 3664 px wide (the east piece stops before the pit, see the note); past it is the unused rest of the 6144-px slot.

donor_bottom_boundary.note: the prototype's LevelSize row for HPZ act 1 is the generic $0720 (1824); paste dy is 0.

unbounded_fall.why: THE ACT HAS NO BOTTOM: every painted column has air below its last landing surface (Sonic 2's terrain interiors are LRB-only). Sonic 2 survives this with a level bottom boundary that kills; this engine has no death, so a body under the terrain falls forever. THE COUNT IS THE CHECK: a floor, a death plane or a bottom boundary drops it, and clip_reachability says so.

clips.unaligned_dst_reason: v2.1's Hidden Palace L: the east piece is the SAME donor rectangle as the west piece, pasted with the same offset (-4688, 0), so its origin sits at donor y 1504, off the section grid by construction (docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-woven.md, v2.1 'What changed').
